integrity: The recent paper supplies the arbitrary-state block-partition upper scale; the new claim is the exact W-state best-partition lower law. The proof is analytic. Numerical checks in the package are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite best-partition formula is stated for q dividing n.
The result proves order sharpness of the block-product relaxation, not optimality of the constant in the recent upper bound.
No lower bound is claimed for the complete testing or learning sample complexity.
title: W states make the block-product relaxation loss order-one-over-q sharp
